chapter: Family and early memories of Jelly
title: First nightclub: the Plantation with King Oliver in Chicago
summary: In 1925 she was struck by the watermelon decorations at the Plantation, where Albert Nicholas played with King Oliver.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
